step.command: PID=${BPFREJIT_OTEL_MAP_INLINE_PID:?OTEL map_inline worker PID is required}; PY_MAP=; for f in ${MAP_VALUES}/map-*.show.json; do if [ "$(jq -r .name "$f")" = py_procs ]; then PY_MAP=$(jq -r .id "$f"); break; fi; done; if [ -z "$PY_MAP" ]; then echo "OTEL map_inline: py_procs map is missing" >&2; exit 1; fi; PY_KEY=$(printf '%02x%02x%02x%02x' $((PID & 255)) $(((PID >> 8) & 255)) $(((PID >> 16) & 255)) $(((PID >> 24) & 255))); PY_DUMP=${MAP_VALUES}/map-${PY_MAP}.dump.json; if ! jq -e --arg key "$PY_KEY" 'any(.[]?; ((.key // []) | map(sub("^0x"; "") | ascii_downcase) | join("")) == $key)' "$PY_DUMP" >/dev/null; then echo "OTEL map_inline: worker PID $PID key $PY_KEY is absent from $PY_DUMP" >&2; exit 1; fi; bpfopt --pass map_inline --input ${INPUT} --output ${OUTPUT} --report ${REPORT} --prog-type ${PROG_TYPE} -- --map-values ${MAP_VALUES} --map-ids ${MAP_IDS} --stability phase-stable --only-hinted --inline-hint=py_procs:$PY_KEY
step.name: map_inline
